content.short: DEMU aims to create tools that will empower musicians & record labels to directly manage their music business.
content.description: Our mission is to provide artists worldwide with the tools they need to manage the license and sale of their music, empowering them to be in control of their own music business. Our vision is to foster an environment where artists are empowered and well-equipped, eliminating the exploitation stemming from a lack of resources or tools. Goals: Launch the DEMU Jukebox, a platform where artists can act as their own bank, streaming platform, and record store, all in one. Like Shopify, for musicians.
content.meta: Find out about DEMU (DEMU) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
